_what: THE FORCE-MAJEURE DRAFT EXCLUSION — an OWNER DECLARATION, not a derived quantity. Two pick-1 key forwards whose careers ended by force majeure rather than by failing. They are struck out of the draft record entirely and every selection behind them in their own draft slides up one pick, so no ordinal loses an observation.
_owner_word_2026-09-01: McCartin and Boyd should be excluded from everything. It's as if they weren't picked. So when looking at the value of pick 1 for the PVC, they didn't happen. For looking at KPF value for v0, they didn't happen. For your draft day analytics, they didn't happen.
_standing_ruling: ENGINE_PRIMER.md §4.5 — 'Paddy McCartin and Tom Boyd (pick-1 KPF busts, force majeure) are excluded by owner ruling; every player in their drafts slides up one pick.'
_why_a_file_and_not_a_store_field: The lander's store-edit verb refuses to CREATE a field by design ('a field that is not there is not a field that is wrong'), and a bespoke store writer to add one would bypass the only sanctioned store lane. So the declaration lives here, beside the owner's other declarations, and the surfaces that honour it read it from here.
_who_reads_this: ui/tools/gen_draft_outcomes.py — drops both selections and slides the rest of their draft up one
